# surviver

**surviver** estimates vaccine effectiveness as a function of time since
vaccination, VE(t), from individual-level data on vaccination and
reported infections.

Each person’s hazard of infection is driven by the force of infection
they are exposed to, built from reported cases and an age-structured
contact matrix. Vaccination multiplies that hazard by exp(γ(t)), where
γ(t) varies with time since vaccination:

``` math
\log h = \log\beta + \log \bar I(t_c, a) + \gamma(t)\,V,
\qquad \mathrm{VE}(t) = 1 - e^{\gamma(t)}
```

The model is a Poisson approximation to a Cox model, fitted in
[Stan](https://mc-stan.org/) with a random-walk prior on γ(t), so VE can
rise, plateau and wane without assuming a functional form.

> **Status: experimental.** See the [lab
> notebook](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/articles/lab-notebook.html)
> for what has been checked and the open issues.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("kylieainslie/surviver")
```

Fitting models needs [cmdstanr](https://mc-stan.org/cmdstanr/) and
CmdStan, which are not on CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("cmdstanr", repos = c("https://stan-dev.r-universe.dev", getOption("repos")))
cmdstanr::install_cmdstan()
```

## Example

Estimate VE(t) from a simulated dataset where the true VE is known:

``` r

library(surviver)

# person-level data: demographics, vaccination and reported cases
pop <- ve_population(ve_sim_waning)

# force of infection by day and age group, from reported cases
inc  <- daily_incidence(pop)
prev <- daily_prevalence(inc, duration_infection = 7, reporting_delay = 2)
foi  <- force_of_infection(prev, age_group_sizes(pop), contact_matrix = polymod_nl)

# person-days split at vaccination, aggregated for Stan. People reported
# within 7 days of vaccination are censored at vaccination (probably
# infected before it)
early <- reported_soon_after_vaccination(pop, window = 7)
pd <- expand_person_days(counting_process(pop, censor_at_vaccination = early))
sd <- make_stan_data(pd, foi)

# fit and plot against the true curve (VE is not estimable for the first
# 7 days after vaccination once early cases are censored)
fit <- fit_ve(sd, seed = 42)
ve  <- extract_ve(fit)
plot_ve(ve[ve$days_since_vax > 7, ], truth = ve_sim_waning$params)
```

![Estimated VE (blue, with 90% credible interval) against the true VE
(red dashed) for the two simulated
scenarios.](reference/figures/README-ve-fit.png)

Estimated VE (blue, with 90% credible interval) against the true VE (red
dashed) for the two simulated scenarios.

The [Get
started](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/articles/surviver.html)
vignette shows the epidemic dynamics and the model fit to cases.

To use your own data, pass
[`ve_population()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/ve_population.md)
a folder containing `demographic_data.rds`, `vaccination_data.rds` and
`incidence_data_reduced.rds`, or a list with `demographic`,
`vaccination` and `incidence` data frames (see
[`?ve_population`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/ve_population.md)).

## Main functions

| Step | Functions |
|----|----|
| Prepare data | [`ve_population()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/ve_population.md), [`sample_cohort()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/sample_cohort.md), [`daily_incidence()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/daily_incidence.md), [`counting_process()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/counting_process.md), [`reported_soon_after_vaccination()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/reported_soon_after_vaccination.md), [`expand_person_days()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/expand_person_days.md) |
| Exposure | [`daily_prevalence()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/daily_prevalence.md), [`age_group_sizes()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/age_group_sizes.md), [`force_of_infection()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/force_of_infection.md), [`contact_matrix_hermes()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/contact_matrix_hermes.md) |
| Fit the model | [`make_stan_data()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/make_stan_data.md), [`fit_ve()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/fit_ve.md), [`extract_ve()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/extract_ve.md), [`plot_ve()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/plot_ve.md), [`expected_cases()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/expected_cases.md) |
| Validation | [`true_ve()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/true_ve.md), [`simulate_counts()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/simulate_counts.md) |

Two Stan models are bundled
([`ve_stan_file()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/ve_stan_file.md)):
`"noncentered"` (default) and `"centered"` parameterisations of the
random walk.

## Data

| Dataset | Description |
|----|----|
| `ve_sim_waning` | Simulated outbreak, 10,000 people, 180 days. VE rises to 0.8 over 14 days, then wanes (half-life 45 days) towards 0.1 |
| `ve_sim_no_waning` | As above, but VE stays at 0.8 after the ramp |
| `polymod_nl` | [POLYMOD](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pmed.0050074) contact matrix for the Netherlands, five age groups |

The simulated datasets were generated with
[HERMES](https://github.com/lwillem/ibm_hermes), an individual-based
transmission model by Lander Willem (see its [user
manual](https://github.com/lwillem/ibm_hermes/blob/lorentz_center_workshop/doc/user_manual_HERMES.pdf)),
extended so that vaccine protection wanes
([`waning-vaccine-effectiveness`](https://github.com/kylieainslie/ibm_hermes/tree/waning-vaccine-effectiveness)
branch). `data-raw/ve_test_scenarios.R` regenerates them from a local
clone of HERMES (set `HERMES_PATH`).

## Development

- [Handover
  notes](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/articles/handover.html):
  where everything lives, setup, how to regenerate or adapt the
  simulations, and what to do next.
- [Lab
  notebook](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/articles/lab-notebook.html):
  dated record of how the method and data were developed, and every
  check.
- `dev/checks/`: scripts that reproduce each lab-notebook entry.
- `data-raw/`: scripts that build the package datasets.

## Acknowledgements

The method was developed by Group D at the Lorentz Center workshop
[*Connecting Survival Analysis and Infectious Disease
Modeling*](https://www.lorentzcenter.nl/connecting-survival-analysis-and-infectious-disease-modeling.html)
(Leiden, June 2026): Fanny Bergström, David Price, Nathalie Dean, Hein
Putter and Kylie Ainslie. The simulated data use
[HERMES](https://github.com/lwillem/ibm_hermes) by Lander Willem.

# Package index

## Prepare data

Build person-level, daily and counting-process data from vaccination and
case records.

- [`ve_population()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/ve_population.md)
  : Build a person-level table from VE input data
- [`sample_cohort()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/sample_cohort.md)
  : Randomly sample a cohort
- [`add_age_group()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/add_age_group.md)
  : Add an age-group column
- [`default_age_breaks`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/default_age_breaks.md)
  [`default_age_labels`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/default_age_breaks.md)
  : Default age groups
- [`daily_incidence()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/daily_incidence.md)
  : Daily cases and population at risk
- [`counting_process()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/counting_process.md)
  : Counting-process data with time-varying vaccination
- [`reported_soon_after_vaccination()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/reported_soon_after_vaccination.md)
  : People reported soon after vaccination
- [`expand_person_days()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/expand_person_days.md)
  : Expand counting-process data to person-days

## Exposure

Daily infectious pressure (force of infection) by age group.

- [`daily_prevalence()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/daily_prevalence.md)
  : Daily number infectious
- [`age_group_sizes()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/age_group_sizes.md)
  : Population size by age group
- [`force_of_infection()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/force_of_infection.md)
  : Daily force-of-infection offset
- [`contact_matrix_hermes()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/contact_matrix_hermes.md)
  : Contact matrix implied by a HERMES population

## Fit the VE model

Poisson approximation to a Cox model with a random walk on the log
hazard ratio over days since vaccination.

- [`make_stan_data()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/make_stan_data.md)
  : Build Stan input for the time-varying VE model
- [`ve_stan_file()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/ve_stan_file.md)
  : Path to a bundled Stan model
- [`fit_ve()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/fit_ve.md)
  : Fit the time-varying VE model
- [`extract_ve()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/extract_ve.md)
  : Summarise VE by day since vaccination
- [`plot_ve()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/plot_ve.md)
  : Plot estimated VE by day since vaccination
- [`expected_cases()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/expected_cases.md)
  : Observed and model-expected case counts

## Validation

Helpers for checking the method against known truth.

- [`true_ve()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/true_ve.md)
  : True VE curve used in the HERMES simulations
- [`simulate_counts()`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/simulate_counts.md)
  : Simulate event counts from the VE model

## Data

- [`ve_sim_waning`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/ve_sim.md)
  [`ve_sim_no_waning`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/ve_sim.md)
  : Simulated ground-truth data for time-varying vaccine effectiveness
- [`polymod_nl`](https://kylieainslie.github.io/surviver/reference/polymod_nl.md)
  : POLYMOD contact matrix for the Netherlands
